tools.name: create_openings_from_clash
tools.description: Create and cut openings where MEP crosses a wall, floor, beam, column, or roof. Pick the hosts in the form, or leave that empty to use the current selection. Nearby hits on the same host combine when the leftover strip cannot act as a pier; they stay separate if the remaining edge is too thin or the opening would exceed two-thirds of the host length. A combined width over 700 mm is reported, not blocked. A section box is not a host. Shipped opening families load automatically. dryRun counts only and reports No model changes.

tools.name: cut_hosts_by_openings
tools.description: Repair local host cuts after an opening family reload. The usual path is create_openings_from_clash, which places and cuts in one step. Pick openings or hosts, or leave both empty to use the current selection. Linked hosts are skipped, not cut.
